name: Tokamak
mechanism: A toroidal plasma is confined by fields from external coils and a large current in the plasma.
diagram_steps: Draw a torus with an empty central hole and surrounding toroidal coils.
Add a plasma-current arrow around the torus.
Show helical field lines from combined toroidal and poloidal components.
Cut away the outer wall to show blanket, coolant and heat exhaust.
proposed_advantage: Largest body of relevant high-performance magnetic-plasma experiments.
key_open_challenge: Disruptions, current drive, heat exhaust, fuel cycle and neutron-resistant components.
diagram_guardrail: The central solenoid induces plasma current; it does not directly create all confining poloidal field by itself. Stronger field is not a free improvement; magnet stress, shielding and space matter.
interpretation_label: Mechanism facts plus explicitly interpretive engineering tradeoffs

name: Spherical tokamak
mechanism: A tokamak with a comparatively small central hole and rounded, elongated plasma cross-section.
diagram_steps: Start from the tokamak diagram.
Shrink the central hole while keeping a center column.
Show a vertical cross-section with a compact center stack.
Highlight the limited room for shielding and blanket at the center.
key_open_challenge: Center-column protection, maintainability and power-exhaust integration.
diagram_guardrail: Not a solid sphere of plasma; a center column remains. Compact size alone does not establish low plant cost.
interpretation_label: Mechanism facts plus explicitly interpretive engineering tradeoffs

name: Stellarator
mechanism: External magnets create a three-dimensional twisted confining field without requiring a large transformer-driven plasma current.
diagram_steps: Draw a toroidal plasma with a gently changing three-dimensional cross-section.
Reveal nonplanar or alternative optimized external magnets.
Trace a field line around the torus.
Keep coolant and blanket outside the plasma.
proposed_advantage: Natural route to continuous operation and reduced large-current disruption burden.
key_open_challenge: Precision manufacture, field errors, particle confinement, blanket access and remote maintenance.
diagram_guardrail: Do not draw plasma as following a single literal twisted pipe or imply zero plasma current, zero instability, or solved steady-state power generation.
interpretation_label: Mechanism facts plus explicitly interpretive engineering tradeoffs

name: Magnetic mirror
mechanism: A linear magnetic field strengthens near both ends, reflecting many charged particles while some escape through the ends.
diagram_steps: Draw a linear plasma chamber.
Place stronger magnetic throats at both ends.
Animate some particle paths reflecting and some escaping.
Show heating beams and end exhaust collection.
proposed_advantage: Relatively direct geometry and potentially simpler component access.
key_open_challenge: Axial particle losses and sustaining efficient high-performance confinement.
diagram_guardrail: Magnetic mirrors are not solid plugs and do not reflect every particle. Do not confuse 17 T magnet field with confinement or electrical gain.
interpretation_label: Mechanism facts plus explicitly interpretive engineering tradeoffs

name: Beam sustained field reversed configuration
mechanism: A compact plasma configuration has closed field regions formed by plasma currents; neutral beams can create, heat and sustain it.
diagram_steps: Draw an elongated central chamber without a material center post.
Show plasma-current loops and reversed field direction in the core.
Add neutral beams entering the plasma.
Distinguish current experiment fuel from eventual advanced fuel.
proposed_advantage: High plasma pressure relative to magnetic pressure and a linear external layout.
key_open_challenge: Confinement and beam efficiency at reactor conditions, plus advanced-fuel radiation and temperature requirements.
diagram_guardrail: Use updated Norm beam-formation architecture rather than depicting all TAE machines as Helion-style colliding plasmoids. A field-reversed plasma is not a permanent-magnet ring.
interpretation_label: Mechanism facts plus explicitly interpretive engineering tradeoffs

name: Pulsed compressed field reversed configuration
mechanism: Compact FRC plasmas are formed, accelerated and compressed in a pulsed magnetic system; an expanding plasma can return energy electromagnetically.
diagram_steps: Form two plasmoids at opposite ends.
Move them into the central region.
Compress the merged plasma with a stronger field.
Show expansion inducing current in coils and a separate input-energy loop.
proposed_advantage: Possible direct electrical conversion and recovery of some pulse energy.
key_open_challenge: Fusion energy output, recovery efficiency, advanced-fuel supply and repeated integrated net electrical output.
diagram_guardrail: Returned pulse energy includes previously supplied energy; do not label all returned current as new fusion electricity. D-He3 is the intended fuel, not proof every experiment used it.
interpretation_label: Mechanism facts plus explicitly interpretive engineering tradeoffs

name: Sheared flow stabilized Z-pinch
mechanism: Current through a plasma column creates a magnetic field that pinches it inward; flow varying across the column is used to suppress instability.
diagram_steps: Draw a narrow axial plasma column.
Send current along the column.
Show circular magnetic-field arrows and inward force.
Animate axial layers with different velocities.
proposed_advantage: Avoids large external confinement magnets and a high-energy laser driver.
key_open_challenge: Stability and gain at high current, electrode life, liquid-metal engineering and rapid repetition.
diagram_guardrail: No external magnet does not mean no magnetic field. Do not treat a repetitive engineering platform power rating as fusion output.
interpretation_label: Mechanism facts plus explicitly interpretive engineering tradeoffs

name: Mechanically compressed magnetized target
mechanism: A preformed magnetized plasma is compressed rapidly by a surrounding mechanical or liquid-metal system.
diagram_steps: Create a magnetized plasma target.
Show surrounding liner or liquid wall.
Compress inward and raise density and temperature.
Show intended heat capture and reset between pulses.
proposed_advantage: Liquid walls could combine shielding, heat collection and fuel breeding.
key_open_challenge: Compression symmetry, plasma-wall mixing, integrated gain and durable repeatable operation.
diagram_guardrail: Distinguish solid-lithium experimental liners from proposed renewable liquid-metal plant walls; commercial liquid-wall benefits are design aims.
interpretation_label: Mechanism facts plus explicitly interpretive engineering tradeoffs

name: Laser inertial fusion with indirect drive
mechanism: Laser beams heat a hohlraum; the resulting X-rays ablate a fuel capsule and drive an inward implosion.
diagram_steps: Show laser beams entering openings in a hohlraum.
Turn inner wall energy into X-rays.
Show capsule surface blowing outward.
Show the recoil compressing fuel inward, then brief fusion burn.
proposed_advantage: Physical ignition and target gain above one have been experimentally demonstrated at NIF.
key_open_challenge: Efficient high-repetition lasers, much larger useful gain, mass-produced targets and chamber recovery.
diagram_guardrail: Lasers do not directly squeeze the capsule; outward ablation drives implosion. NIF evidence applies to the physics family, not automatically to a startup plant.
interpretation_label: Mechanism facts plus explicitly interpretive engineering tradeoffs

name: Laser inertial fusion with direct drive
mechanism: Laser beams illuminate the capsule directly; ablation accelerates the remaining fuel inward.
diagram_steps: Draw a spherical capsule with lasers aimed at its exterior.
Show an outward ablation layer and inward compression.
Show the short hot spot and burn.
Add an optional separate fast-ignition beam only for designs that use one.
proposed_advantage: Potentially better coupling of laser energy to the capsule.
key_open_challenge: Illumination uniformity, laser-plasma interactions, high gain and repetitive plant hardware.
diagram_guardrail: Direct drive is not direct electricity conversion. Fast ignition and shock ignition are subtypes, not properties of every direct-drive design.
interpretation_label: Mechanism facts plus explicitly interpretive engineering tradeoffs

name: Pulsed power liner inertial fusion
mechanism: A very large electrical pulse creates a magnetic force that implodes a liner or target; some versions add fuel magnetization and laser preheat.
diagram_steps: Charge a pulsed-power bank.
Drive current into a liner.
Show inward electromagnetic force compressing the fuel.
Show separate axial pre-magnetization and laser preheat only for MagLIF.
proposed_advantage: Efficient electrical pulse delivery may reduce the laser-driver burden.
key_open_challenge: High-gain target design, consumable transmission components, chamber clearing and repetition.
diagram_guardrail: Sandia MagLIF and Pacific Fusion have different implementations; do not copy all MagLIF hardware into every pulsed-power diagram.
interpretation_label: Mechanism facts plus explicitly interpretive engineering tradeoffs

name: Levitated dipole
mechanism: Plasma surrounds the dipole field of a levitated superconducting ring inside the chamber.
diagram_steps: Draw an internal superconducting ring inside a vacuum vessel.
Show dipole field lines around the ring.
Place the plasma around those field lines.
Show the ring cooling and shielding problem separately from plasma heating.
proposed_advantage: A distinct confinement geometry with simple-looking axisymmetric topology.
key_open_challenge: Reactor-relevant confinement and protection, cooling and maintenance of an internal magnet.
diagram_guardrail: The ring is inside the chamber; do not draw an external-coil tokamak or treat prototype operation as D-T gain.

name: Magneto-electrostatic confinement
mechanism: An electric field confines energetic ions while a magnetic field helps confine electrons.
diagram_steps: Draw a central electrode and the surrounding vessel.
Show ion orbits separately from electron confinement.
Add electric and magnetic field legends.
Show power supplied to the high-voltage system.
proposed_advantage: Compact architecture and potential applications at small scales.
key_open_challenge: Losses, space charge, energy distribution, high voltage and a complete reactor energy balance.
diagram_guardrail: High voltage is an input or operating condition, not fusion output.

name: Hybrid direct-drive laser fusion
mechanism: An initial laser pulse produces X-rays in a hohlraum; subsequent laser pulses directly drive the capsule.
diagram_steps: Show two-sided laser access to a target assembly.
Use the initial pulse to heat the hohlraum and X-ray-ablate the capsule.
Show later pulses driving the capsule directly.
Show compression and proposed burn, followed by target replacement and chamber recovery.
proposed_advantage: Combining indirect and direct stages seeks efficient coupling and controlled compression.
key_open_challenge: Target design validation, efficient high-energy drivers, repetition, target cost and chamber lifetime must work together.
diagram_guardrail: This target design is not a fast-ignition sequence and not ordinary NIF indirect drive; modeled target performance is not a measured company gain.

name: Two-stage hybrid fast ignition
mechanism: A designed fuel package separates compression from a later rapid ignition step.
diagram_steps: Draw a fuel-system module.
Show the compression driver.
Add a distinct ignition trigger.
Show proposed heat capture and reset, with partner systems labeled.
proposed_advantage: Separating compression and ignition can change the requirements placed on each stage.
key_open_challenge: Integrated compression, ignition coupling, high gain, driver interfaces and repetition.
diagram_guardrail: First Light FLARE is not its older projectile-only roadmap; modeled gain is not a measured shot.
